name: Plastic Packaging Tax
heroIntro: Plastic Packaging Tax applies to plastic packaging made in, or imported into, the UK that contains less than 30% recycled plastic. Find out in two questions whether you're liable, and let us handle the data behind your quarterly returns.
ctaTitle: Find out exactly what you owe.
ctaText: Tell us what plastic packaging you make or import. We'll work out whether you're liable, what you'll pay each quarter, and the records you need to keep.
checks: the 2026/27 rate of £228.82 per tonne (from 1 April 2026)
